tools.name: addBillboard
tools.description: Add an image billboard at geographic coordinates. Returns { success: boolean, data?: unknown, message?: string, error?: string }.

tools.name: addBox
tools.description: Add a three-dimensional box entity. Returns { success: boolean, data?: unknown, message?: string, error?: string }.

tools.name: addCorridor
tools.description: Add a corridor with a geographic centerline and width. Returns { success: boolean, data?: unknown, message?: string, error?: string }.

tools.name: addCylinder
tools.description: Add a cylinder or cone entity. Returns { success: boolean, data?: unknown, message?: string, error?: string }.

tools.name: addEllipse
tools.description: Add an ellipse or circle entity. Returns { success: boolean, data?: unknown, message?: string, error?: string }.

tools.name: addGeoJsonLayer
tools.description: Add a styled GeoJSON Point, LineString, or Polygon layer. Returns { success, data: { id, name, type, visible, color, dataRefId? }, message? }; use id with highlight.

data.description: GeoJSON FeatureCollection containing Point, LineString, or Polygon features

properties.description: Feature attributes used for labels and thematic styling

color.description: CSS color such as #3B82F6 or rgba(59,130,246,0.8)

items.description: CSS color such as #3B82F6 or rgba(59,130,246,0.8)
CSS color such as #3B82F6 or rgba(59,130,246,0.8)
CSS color such as #3B82F6 or rgba(59,130,246,0.8)

tools.name: addGeoJsonPrimitive
tools.description: Render GeoJSON as Cesium primitives for large browser datasets. Returns { success: boolean, data?: unknown, message?: string, error?: string }.

tools.name: addHeatmap
tools.description: Add a heatmap from GeoJSON point features. Returns { success: boolean, data?: unknown, message?: string, error?: string }.

tools.name: addLabel
tools.description: Add property-based text labels for GeoJSON features. Returns { success, data: { labelCount: integer }, message? }.

data.description: GeoJSON FeatureCollection containing Point, LineString, or Polygon features

properties.description: Feature attributes used for labels and thematic styling

fillColor.description: CSS color such as #3B82F6 or rgba(59,130,246,0.8)

outlineColor.description: CSS color such as #3B82F6 or rgba(59,130,246,0.8)

backgroundColor.description: CSS color such as #3B82F6 or rgba(59,130,246,0.8)

tools.name: addMarker
tools.description: Add a point marker at geographic coordinates. Returns { success, data: { entityId }, message? }; keep entityId for removeEntity.

color.description: CSS color such as #3B82F6 or rgba(59,130,246,0.8)

tools.name: addModel
tools.description: Add a glTF or GLB model at geographic coordinates. Returns { success: boolean, data?: unknown, message?: string, error?: string }.

tools.name: addPolygon
tools.description: Draw a polygon area from geographic coordinate tuples. Returns { success, data: { entityId }, message? }; keep entityId for removeEntity.

color.description: CSS color such as #3B82F6 or rgba(59,130,246,0.8)

outlineColor.description: CSS color such as #3B82F6 or rgba(59,130,246,0.8)

tools.name: addPolyline
tools.description: Draw a path or route from geographic coordinate tuples. Returns { success, data: { entityId }, message? }; keep entityId for removeEntity.

color.description: CSS color such as #3B82F6 or rgba(59,130,246,0.8)

tools.name: addRectangle
tools.description: Add a geographic rectangle entity. Returns { success: boolean, data?: unknown, message?: string, error?: string }.

tools.name: addWall
tools.description: Add a wall along geographic positions. Returns { success: boolean, data?: unknown, message?: string, error?: string }.

tools.name: batchAddEntities
tools.description: Add multiple supported entities in one page operation. Returns { success: boolean, data?: unknown, message?: string, error?: string }.

tools.name: clearAll
tools.description: Clear all layers, entities, animations, and trajectories from the scene. Returns { success, data: { removedLayers, removedEntities }, message? }.

tools.name: controlAnimation
tools.description: Play or pause the Cesium clock animation. Returns { success: boolean, data?: unknown, message?: string, error?: string }.

tools.name: controlClock
tools.description: Configure Cesium simulation time, current time, speed, or range. Returns { success: boolean, data?: unknown, message?: string, error?: string }.

tools.name: createAnimation
tools.description: Create a time-dynamic entity moving through ISO-timestamped waypoints. Returns { success: boolean, data?: unknown, message?: string, error?: string }.

tools.name: exportScene
tools.description: Export the current view, layer, and entity state as JSON. Returns { success: boolean, data?: unknown, message?: string, error?: string }.

tools.name: flyTo
tools.description: Animate the camera to a geographic location. Use for visible navigation requested by the user. Returns { success: boolean, message?: string, error?: string }.

height.description: Height above the ellipsoid in meters

tools.name: geocode
tools.description: Convert an address or place name to geographic coordinates using OSM Nominatim. Returns { success, longitude?, latitude?, displayName?, boundingBox?, message? }.

tools.name: getEntityProperties
tools.description: Read the properties and graphics metadata for one entity. Returns { success: boolean, data?: unknown, message?: string, error?: string }.

tools.name: getLayerSchema
tools.description: Inspect fields, entity counts, and metadata for a layer. Returns { success: boolean, data?: unknown, message?: string, error?: string }.

tools.name: getView
tools.description: Get the current camera position and orientation. Returns { success, data: { longitude, latitude, height, heading, pitch, roll }, message? }.

tools.name: highlight
tools.description: Highlight one feature or every feature in a GeoJSON layer. Returns { success: boolean, message?: string, error?: string }.

color.description: CSS color such as #3B82F6 or rgba(59,130,246,0.8)

tools.name: listAnimations
tools.description: List animated entities in the current page. Returns { success: boolean, data?: unknown, message?: string, error?: string }.

tools.name: listLayers
tools.description: List all layers currently managed by the page. Returns { success: boolean, data?: unknown, message?: string, error?: string }.

tools.name: listViewpoints
tools.description: List camera viewpoints saved in the current page. Returns { success: boolean, data?: unknown, message?: string, error?: string }.

tools.name: load3dGaussianSplat
tools.description: Load a 3D Gaussian Splat tileset from a URL. Returns { success: boolean, data?: unknown, message?: string, error?: string }.

tools.name: load3dTiles
tools.description: Load a 3D Tiles tileset from a URL or Cesium ion asset. Returns { success: boolean, data?: unknown, message?: string, error?: string }.

tools.name: loadCzml
tools.description: Load CZML data from inline packets or a URL. Returns { success: boolean, data?: unknown, message?: string, error?: string }.

tools.name: loadImageryService
tools.description: Load WMS, WMTS, XYZ, ArcGIS MapServer, or ion imagery. Returns { success: boolean, data?: unknown, message?: string, error?: string }.

tools.name: loadKml
tools.description: Load KML or KMZ data from inline text or a URL. Returns { success: boolean, data?: unknown, message?: string, error?: string }.

tools.name: loadTerrain
tools.description: Switch the Cesium terrain provider. Returns { success: boolean, data?: unknown, message?: string, error?: string }.

tools.name: loadViewpoint
tools.description: Restore a previously saved page-local camera state. Returns { success: boolean, data?: unknown, message?: string, error?: string }.

tools.name: lookAtTransform
tools.description: Aim the camera at a geographic target with heading, pitch, and range. Returns { success: boolean, data?: unknown, message?: string, error?: string }.

tools.name: measure
tools.description: Measure distance or area between geographic coordinate tuples. Returns { success, data: { mode, value, unit, segments?, id? }, message? }.

tools.name: playTrajectory
tools.description: Play a moving entity along geographic coordinate tuples. Returns { success: boolean, data?: unknown, message?: string, error?: string }.

tools.name: queryEntities
tools.description: Query page entities by name, type, or geographic extent. Returns { success: boolean, data?: unknown, message?: string, error?: string }.

tools.name: removeAnimation
tools.description: Remove one animated entity. Returns { success: boolean, data?: unknown, message?: string, error?: string }.

tools.name: removeEntity
tools.description: Remove one entity created by an entity tool. Returns { success, message? } or { success: false, error } when entityId is not found.

tools.name: removeLayer
tools.description: Remove a managed layer from the page. Returns { success: boolean, data?: unknown, message?: string, error?: string }.

tools.name: saveViewpoint
tools.description: Save the current camera state under a page-local name. Returns { success: boolean, data?: unknown, message?: string, error?: string }.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Capture the current Cesium map view as a PNG image. Returns { success, data: { dataUrl, width, height }, message? }; dataUrl is a base64 PNG.

tools.name: setBasemap
tools.description: Switch the visible basemap style. Returns { success, data: { basemap }, message? }.

tools.name: setCameraOptions
tools.description: Configure Cesium camera input and zoom constraints. Returns { success: boolean, data?: unknown, message?: string, error?: string }.

tools.name: setEdgeDisplayMode
tools.description: Set surface and edge rendering mode for one or all 3D Tiles layers. Returns { success: boolean, data?: unknown, message?: string, error?: string }.

tools.name: setGlobeLighting
tools.description: Configure globe lighting and atmosphere lighting. Returns { success: boolean, data?: unknown, message?: string, error?: string }.

tools.name: setLayerVisibility
tools.description: Show or hide a managed layer. Returns { success: boolean, data?: unknown, message?: string, error?: string }.

tools.name: setPostProcess
tools.description: Configure bloom, ambient occlusion, and FXAA post-processing. Returns { success: boolean, data?: unknown, message?: string, error?: string }.

tools.name: setSceneOptions
tools.description: Configure fog, atmosphere, shadows, celestial bodies, terrain depth testing, and background. Returns { success: boolean, data?: unknown, message?: string, error?: string }.

tools.name: setView
tools.description: Set the camera position immediately without animation. Use for deterministic setup or instant view changes. Returns { success: boolean, message?: string, error?: string }.

height.description: Height above the ellipsoid in meters

tools.name: startOrbit
tools.description: Start continuous camera orbit around the current target. Returns { success: boolean, data?: unknown, message?: string, error?: string }.

tools.name: stopOrbit
tools.description: Stop a camera orbit started by startOrbit. Returns { success: boolean, data?: unknown, message?: string, error?: string }.

tools.name: trackEntity
tools.description: Track an entity with the Cesium camera, or stop tracking when entityId is omitted. Returns { success: boolean, data?: unknown, message?: string, error?: string }.

tools.name: updateAnimationPath
tools.description: Update the path appearance of an animated entity. Returns { success: boolean, data?: unknown, message?: string, error?: string }.

tools.name: updateEntity
tools.description: Update the position, appearance, label, or visibility of an entity. Returns { success: boolean, data?: unknown, message?: string, error?: string }.

tools.name: updateLayerStyle
tools.description: Update vector, imagery, primitive, or 3D Tiles styling for a layer. Returns { success: boolean, data?: unknown, message?: string, error?: string }.

tools.name: zoomToExtent
tools.description: Animate the camera to a west/south/east/north bounding box. Returns { success: boolean, data?: unknown, message?: string, error?: string }.
